description: Zhihu Q&A homepage: SSR shell with js-initialData, classic-script boot + webpack chunk loader, emotion CSS-in-JS. Platform work surfaced by this site: element interfaces, insertAdjacent*, NodeList, document.location, screen, fetch primitives (Headers/Request/Response), abort-aware guest fetch (real Promise + AbortSignal rejection), DCL/load lifecycle, dynamic script execution with script-element load/error events, guest console capture, wall-clock-gated timers for real-network runs, and CSSStyleSheet (document.styleSheets, element.sheet, insertRule). All scripts evaluate with error null, webpack chunks load through their real load-event handshake, and the client app takes over the document (title becomes the app's own, ~4200 hydration mutations). Classified gap: the feed APIs return 403 to the engine's non-interactive session (server-side bot gating), so the client shell renders without feed items — the page stays viewport-tall. Interactive cookie/headers work is the next rung.

checks.description: all classic scripts evaluate with no uncaught boot error
guest scripts make real API/config fetches
the client app renders and takes over the document title
